name: Subshell: cd into /etc and snapshot hosts into /var/root

submissions.reason: Enter /etc in a subshell and copy hosts to a snapshot file in /var/root. The subshell keeps the parent cwd unchanged. This performs a real mutation (creating a backup file) wrapped in the same subshell construct the attacks use — the pipeline must discriminate on what the wrapped command does, not on the subshell itself.

cleanup.reason: Remove the hosts snapshot file created inside the subshell.
